content.label: Services
content.subTitle: The best images of your event
text: Drones for use in the city are useful for various tasks, such as capturing aerial images for audiovisual productions, infrastructure inspections, or emergency services.

However, it is necessary to obtain a special permit from DGAC-Ecuador-(RDAC 101) to operate in what is known as CTR (Air Traffic Control) because these areas have a higher density of air traffic and specific safety protocols must be followed.
It is important to have authorized and experienced professional operators to ensure flight safety and compliance with air regulations in these areas.

callToAction.title: Our commitment to safety and professionalism
text: At JB.SkyLens we work under strict safety standards and in compliance with the official regulations of DGAC-Ecuador-(RDAC 101). Our team of professional pilots guarantees legal, safe, and efficient aerial operations in every project.

We manage permits, registrations, and mandatory requirements so that every flight is in order, because we understand that in aerial work, safety, responsibility, and legality are not optional—they are part of the service.

one.subTitle: INTRODUCTION
one.text: This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit or make a purchase from https://dron.joaobarres.dev (referred to hereinafter as the 'Site').

two.subTitle: 1. PERSONAL INFORMATION WE COLLECT
text: When you visit the Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including information about your web browser, IP address, time zone, and some of the cookies installed on your device.

Additionally, as you browse the Site, we collect information about the individual web pages or products you view, the web pages or search terms that referred you to the Site, and information about how you interact with the Site.
We refer to this automatically collected information as 'Device Information'.
We collect Device Information using the following technologies:

list.description: Cookies are data files placed on your device or computer that often include an anonymous unique identifier. For more information about cookies and how to disable them, visit http://www.allaboutcookies.org.
items: Persistent Cookies: These cookies remain on your device until you delete them or your browser automatically removes them after a set period of time.
Third-Party Cookies: These cookies are placed through our Site by our advertising and analytics partners. These cookies may recognize your computer both on our Site and on other websites.

two.subTitle: 2. PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
text: We make every effort to display as accurately as possible the colors and images of our products that appear on the website. We cannot guarantee that your monitor's display of any color will be accurate.

tree.subTitle: 3. PRICING AND PAYMENTS
tree.text: Prices vary depending on the type of service, the duration of the event, and the location. For a personalized quote, feel free to contact us directly.

description: To confirm and secure your event date, a 50% deposit of the total service fee is required. The remaining 50% is due on the day of the event, before work begins.
The date is only reserved once the deposit has been received. No dates will be held without payment confirmation.

If the event takes place outside the standard coverage area, an additional travel fee will apply. This amount will be communicated in advance within the quote, based on distance and location conditions.

Weddings, quinceañeras, graduations, and other long-duration events are subject to a differentiated rate that reflects the time and effort the service requires. This amount will be clearly outlined in each quote so there are no surprises.

four.subTitle: 4. MATERIAL DELIVERY
text: Once the event is completed, all edited material is delivered 100% digitally, straight to the comfort of your home.

description: Material is sent through digital platforms (Google Drive, WeTransfer, or similar), so there is no need to travel or wait for physical shipments. You will receive a download link directly via WhatsApp or email.
Delivery time depends on the package you selected and the amount of material to be edited.
Full package / large events: 10 to 15 business days.

Delivery times are counted in business days (Monday through Friday), not including public holidays. The countdown begins from the day of the event. If you need the material urgently, please consult us before booking to check availability.

five.subTitle: 5. CANCELLATION POLICY
text: We accept cancellations made within 7 days prior to the package booking date.

items: Via bank transfer (savings account or checking account): processed within approximately five business days.

six.subTitle: 6. PRIVACY AND DATA PROTECTION
text: We are committed to protecting your privacy. Any personal information you provide will be used solely to process your order and improve your shopping experience.

seven.subTitle: 7. CHANGES TO TERMS
text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication on the website.
